result.topic_en: A note 'ad 15' arguing that the minimum value of the Dirichlet-type integral Omega is attained by an essentially unique function u: the difference lambda' of two minimizers has vanishing derivatives, is constant, vanishes on the boundary and is therefore zero, so u is completely determined up to changes at isolated points.

methods.what: Uniqueness of the minimizer: two minimizers give equal minimum values
Writing a second minimizer as a perturbation u' = u + lambda' gives Omega' = Omega + L', hence L' = 0
